codes.meaning: Useful evidence exists but uncertainty or recheck remains.
Hard evidence/guardrail failure stops the idea or action.
F50 identified a missing layer or non-obvious opportunity.
Source cannot drive commercial activation under current rights.
Evidence is too old for the decision.
Verified contribution is below the required floor.
Decision is supported by current shopper intent/context.
Mission resource budget does not permit execution.
Brain health policy recommends demotion or stop.
System returned to a prior safe state after failure.

rule: Every material Orchestrator decision records one or more reason codes plus evidence refs; reason codes never replace evidence.
